content.title: Could KFC be dethroned? Rivals circle as chicken shops boom in UK
content.summary: The fried chicken market has exploded in the past two years, with heavily backed newcomers such as Popeyes, Dave's and Wingstop appearing on high streets across the country.  For this month's Our Verdict feature, our team of testers tried the 11 biggest movers in the market to see if any of them could give KFC a run for its money - find the results here.  Here we look at what's behind the trend and asking whether KFC's place as the dominant market force is under threat.

content.title: Who does tastiest fried chicken? Taste test ranks top 12 (and KFC isn't top)
content.summary: Fried chicken lovers have more choice then ever after a host of big international players arrived on UK high streets over the last few years.  Dave's, Slim Chickens, Wingstop, Jollibee and Popeyes are all now fighting for some of KFC's market share.  Over the past four months, our testers paid multiple visits to the country's 11 biggest fried chicken chains by branch numbers, plus Dave's due to the social media hype.
